Content following a table whose last row is never closed is still converted

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<table><tr><th>Before</th></tr><tr></table><p>Visible footer</p>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
